release-smoke.description: Pre-release smoke: one quick native class per major area (casting, party, client fx, journal, meditation, wildlife, content, research, commands, monsters, lore, world, mounts and taming, network payloads, mixin targets, shrine sanctuary). A fast sanity check run once before a release; it does not replace the per-area suites.

area-combat-bosses.description: Combat and bosses: damage gates, wild monster pressure, dungeon guardians, battlefields, sleeping blade, a cooperative Ferryman crossing, monsters, aura beasts, Oathbound high knights, boss damage through armour, trees kept out of boss arenas, a Master gauntlet that ends with its world, Deep Ocean enemies & Thalassor boss, Co-Op Trials (Vaelkhor, Kharvok, Nyxara), and overhauled Archivist/Thalassor/Cinder Warden rigs.

area-combat-arts.description: Combat: all fifty sword arts end to end (about 12 minutes on its own).

area-combat-aura.description: Combat: aura wards, sword strings, momentum and aura effects; bound-beast cooldowns reset with the server.

area-rituals-parties.description: Rituals and parties: relay circles, party admission during release, excise, basinfill and farm-spell casts, founding a guild and a coven, mentor tutelage while away, a Sanctuary sparing bosses.

area-regions-worldgen.description: Regions and worldgen: Siltcrest wetlands, rootmolt placement and attack cycle, fungal nursery, reed refuge, rainshield, rune-seal doors, every dungeon's wards holding their rooms against a survival player, the forest White Rabbit leading players into Hollow Tree portals, the 5 Deep Ocean structures, and the Trial living biomes + Sanctum placement.

area-items-crafting.description: Items and crafting: research library, learn-all fusion, familiar content systems, Weaver's Silk stow key, casting gear loot, the backpack menu, the fusion altar menu, and Abyssal Diving gear, weapons & Trench Anvil forging/repair.

area-guis-hud.description: GUIs and HUD: life journal, lore journal, quality settings, screen-effect setting and strain vignette, colour-blind-safe telegraphs, meditation, creature presentation, Cord loadouts.

area-feature-tour.description: Feature tour: broad screenshot walk through the mod's systems.

area-mounts-taming.description: Mounts and taming: book-tamed coffer mimics (follow, chest, pet, stay, save, spill, and iron golems passing a tamed one by while still taking up with an untamed one beside it) and berry-tamed thistle hedgehogs (sit, follow, heal, hoglets), the four Shrine Cats (Yuki, Odie, Freya, Kuro), Sakura Village, Cat Sanctuary dungeon yields/perks/taming/persistence, Lantern Bathhouse, custom mobs/NPCs, Ricochet/Suzu Chime/Ofuda Ward runes, and Archivist/Serpent anti-cheese guards, the first ride on a freshly tamed Ridgeback Stag (bond grows, remount starts fresh), mount bond perks (level speed and health, the sprint-key dash, the landing strike sparing pets, kept through reopen, a new rider starting over), the bonded skyray (the bridle call and its cooldown, flying along the look, slow falling on stepping off, lingering then leaving, one at a time, kept through reopen, unhurt by its rider, the fallen cooldown), Cinnamon's companion upgrades, and Lumi-Seahorse / Pearl-Pup / Singing Moon-Whale.

area-towns-guards.description: Towns and packet guards: inn chests, raid dimensions, session maps, codec round trips, travel commands, bounties, caravans, Room Keys, hamlet standings, and Tidefolk Brine-Merchant trading.

dungeon-ward-seal.description: Dungeon wards: each warded vault and arena built in the open, so nothing its ward covers breaks to a survival player, no dug way reaches a corner the open way does not, the player still takes back what they set down inside, and the ward stops at its own wall.

ferryman-coop.description: The cooperative Ferryman: a registered crossing start whose bell rings its guardian, a lone anchor that stays unpaired, a phase-two anchor that marks both oarsmen, a tell that keeps its impact after losing one challenger, and a shared second count that pays every contributor.

shrine-sanctuary.description: Full Shrine Sanctuary & polish verification suite: Yuki/Odie/Freya/Kuro models & loaf poses, Sakura Villager NPCs & custom mobs, Sakura Village courtyard, 4-floor Cat Sanctuary pagoda trials/buffs/taming/companion powers, Lantern Bathhouse onsen & Fire+Wind RuneSeal, Ricochet (5/2 + decay)/Suzu Chime/Ofuda Ward, Archivist & Rootcoil Serpent anti-cheese, all 9 block-variant recipe tags, plus 32-structure DungeonWardSealTest.

oathbound-knights.description: Oathbound High Knights: 1:1 studio animation verification and full combat mechanics for all 4 Oathbound Knights (Bastion, Blade-Champion, Halberdier, Banner-Marshal).

oathhold-city.description: Oathhold 2,048x2,048 Sovereign Megacity: real Overworld /locate placement, continuous 1,920-block walled span verification, outer/inner landmarks, 750+ named citizens, neutral-until-crime Knights, Guild Request Board, guard-witnessed vandalism/TNT persecution, temporary Watch Stockade imprisonment, live NPC house rebuilding, and 1:1 visual showcase screenshots.

deep-ocean.description: Deep Ocean Expansion 1:1 native suite: all 9 entities, 3 Brine-Merchant professions, Lumi-Seahorse 3D riding + dash, Pearl-Pup taming + treasure sniff, Singing Moon-Whale song + ambergris, Thalassor 3-phase boss + Sovereign Altar respawn, Abyssal Diving Suit, 3D Harpoon/Glaive/Conch/Lantern, Trench Anvil forging/repair, all 5 Deep Ocean structures, and natural deep-ocean placement (sea-1 surface regression).

coop-trials.description: Multiplayer Co-Op Trials 1:1 native suite: Vaelkhor (Leyline Sanctum), Kharvok (Ashen Crucible), Nyxara Apex (Astral Eclipse Vault), Trial biomes & Sanctum locators, and overhauled Archivist/Thalassor/Cinder Warden BedrockGeoRig showcases.

structure-gallery.description: Structure gallery: every registered WilderCord structure found in its own biome on a fixed normal-world seed, placed through the registered path and photographed from two aerial corners, eye level, straight above and inside. Visual evidence for the building work; not part of the gameplay suites.

structure-gallery-a.description: Structure gallery, first half (shards 1-3): the same photographs as structure-gallery, split so each half fits the 10800 s VPS run limit.

structure-gallery-b.description: Structure gallery, second half (shards 4-6): the same photographs as structure-gallery, split so each half fits the 10800 s VPS run limit.
